} .redesign-events-section #recs-event-promos .session-card .session-title, .redesign-events-section #recs-event-promos .session-card .session-info, .redesign-events-section #recs-event-promos .session-card .session-time{ font-family: "Adobe Clean", adobe-clean, "Source Sans Pro", -apple-system, system-ui, "Segoe UI", roboto, ubuntu, "Trebuchet MS", "Lucida Grande", sans-serif; } /* Reorganize session cards */ .redesign-events-section .session-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; box-shadow: none !important; border: 0 !important; background-color: transparent !important; padding: 15px 0 0 0 !important; border-top: 1px solid #e8e8e8 !important; margin-top: 0px !important; border-radius: 0 !important; } /* Move session info to top and style it */ .redesign-events-section .session-info { order: 1; font-size: 12px !important; opacity: .8 !important; margin-bottom: -5px !important; } /* Style session title */ .redesign-events-section .session-title { order: 2; color: rgb(2, 104, 227) !important; } /* Style session time */ .redesign-events-section .session-time { order: 3; margin-top: 0px; font-size: 15px !important; } /* .redesign-events-section .session-card .ta-cta{ display: none; } */ .redesign-events-section .session-time .icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; } .related-events-header{ display: flex; align-items: end; gap: 4px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; color: #333; padding-bottom: 5px; margin-top: 20px; } /* Video clips section */ #recs-video-clips-promos{ border: none !important; background: none !important; padding: 0 !important; } #recs-video-clips-promos h4{ display: none; } #recs-video-clips-promos h3{ display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 18px !important; font-weight: bold; color: #333 !important; padding-bottom: 5px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e8e8e8 !important; } /* Video clip boxes */ .video-clip-box { display: block; text-decoration: none !important; color: inherit !important; margin-bottom: 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e8e8e8; background: white; overflow: hidden; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .video-clip-box:hover { text-decoration: none !important; color: inherit !important; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); transform: translateY(-1px); } .video-clip-content { display: flex; align-items: stretch; } .play-button-section { background-color: #d8edfd; width: 36px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; } .video-info { padding: 10px 15px; line-height: 1.4; background-color: #f8f8f8; } .video-title { font-weight: bold; color: #0268e3; font-size: 16px; } .video-duration { font-size: 16px; } /* Announcements section */ .announcements-section { margin-top: 20px; } .announcements-section > h3 { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 18px !important; font-weight: bold; color: #333 !important; padding-bottom: 5px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e8e8e8 !important; } .announcement-content:first-child { margin-top: 0; padding-top: 0; border-top: none; } #recs-announcements .announcement-content .session-card, #recs-announcements .announcement-content #workfront-sidebar .workfront-container, #recs-announcements .announcement-content .cert-sidebar-container, #recs-announcements .announcement-content #agent-sidebar, #recs-announcements .announcement-content .ta-container{ background: #f8f8f8; position: relative; border: 0; box-shadow: none; border-radius: 15px; padding: 15px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; margin-top: 20px; } #recs-announcements .announcement-content #agent-sidebar .agent-container{ padding: 0; } #recs-announcements .announcement-content .session-card:after, #recs-announcements .announcement-content #workfront-sidebar .workfront-container:after, #recs-announcements .announcement-content .cert-sidebar-container:after, #recs-announcements .announcement-content #agent-sidebar:after, #recs-announcements .announcement-content .ta-container:after{ background: #1373e4; height: 10px; content: ''; z-index: 3; display: block; position: absolute; bottom: 0; width: 100%; left: 0; border-bottom-left-radius: 15px; border-bottom-right-radius: 15px; } #recs-announcements .announcement-content .session-card .session-info, #recs-announcements .announcement-content .ta-container .ta-subtitle{ order: 1; font-size: 12px !important; margin-bottom: 0; color: #858585 !important; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 1; font-family: "Adobe Clean", adobe-clean, "Source Sans Pro", -apple-system, system-ui, "Segoe UI", roboto, ubuntu, "Trebuchet MS", "Lucida Grande", sans-serif; } #recs-announcements .announcement-content .session-card .session-title, #recs-announcements .announcement-content #workfront-sidebar h4, #recs-announcements .announcement-content .cert-sidebar-container h4, #recs-announcements .announcement-content .ta-container .ta-title{ order: 2; font-size: 18px!important; margin: 10px 0 8px; color: #0a0a0a !important; font-weight: bold !important; font-family: "Adobe Clean", adobe-clean, "Source Sans Pro", -apple-system, system-ui, "Segoe UI", roboto, ubuntu, "Trebuchet MS", "Lucida Grande", sans-serif; } #recs-announcements .announcement-content .session-card .session-desc, #recs-announcements .announcement-content #workfront-sidebar p, #recs-announcements .announcement-content .cert-sidebar-container p, #recs-announcements .announcement-content #agent-sidebar p, #recs-announcements .announcement-content .ta-container .ta-text{ order: 3; } #recs-announcements .announcement-content .session-card .ta-cta, #recs-announcements .announcement-content .cert-sidebar-container .cert-cta, #recs-announcements .announcement-content #agent-sidebar .agent-cta, #recs-announcements .announcement-content .ta-container .ta-cta{ order: 4; margin: 0; } #recs-announcements .announcement-content .session-card .register-btn, #recs-announcements .announcement-content #workfront-sidebar .workfront-cta, #recs-announcements .announcement-content .cert-sidebar-container .cert-cta, #recs-announcements .announcement-content #agent-sidebar .agent-cta, #recs-announcements .announcement-content .ta-container .ta-cta{ background: transparent !important; color: #1473e6 !important; font-size: 16px; text-align: left; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 5px; padding-left: 0; justify-content: left; border: none; font-family: "Adobe Clean", adobe-clean, "Source Sans Pro", -apple-system, system-ui, "Segoe UI", roboto, ubuntu, "Trebuchet MS", "Lucida Grande", sans-serif; } #recs-announcements .announcement-content .session-card .register-btn:after, #recs-announcements .announcement-content #workfront-sidebar .workfront-cta:after, #recs-announcements .announcement-content .cert-sidebar-container .cert-cta:after, #recs-announcements .announcement-content #agent-sidebar .agent-cta:after, #recs-announcements .announcement-content .ta-container .ta-cta:after{ content: ''; display: inline-block; margin-left: 8px; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-width: 0 2px 2px 0; border-style: solid; transform: rotateZ(-45deg); margin-top: 3px; } #recs-announcements .announcement-content hr, #recs-announcements .announcement-content > br{ display: none;
